report.summary: Patient P-D004 (age 51, Spanish-speaking, commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit) screened positive for a transportation need on the CMS AHC screener. Today's primary-care appointment (V-D004, 16:00, Clinic) was kept. Home tract 17031610300 has 25.1% no-vehicle households and limited early-morning transit (3 of 4 stops within 800m). Eligibility-checked options: Medicaid Ride Line and Senior Shuttle West are not eligible (commercial insurance; age under 60). Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit) is the only potentially viable option, contingent on a qualifying disability and up to 21 days for certification. RideWell Medical Transport page contained no usable resource information and was not relied upon.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility requires a qualifying disability (not documented in record).

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members; call the number on the card at least 2 business days ahead. NOT ELIGIBLE for this patient (commercial insurance, not Medicaid).

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM. NOT ELIGIBLE for this patient (age 51, requires 60+).
